claim: The check gate now reuses a pass on an identical merged tree, re-runs a failure once before it counts, uses a third of the CPUs for -n auto, and keeps a failing suite's traceback.

citations.quote: A pass is reused on an identical merged tree; a failure is re-run once before it counts; `-n auto` is a third of the CPUs; five flaky tests fixed; a failing suite keeps its traceback
